summary: A 23-year-old man from Parker died while tubing the Arkansas River in Pueblo County; following his death PCSO closed the river to tubing/swimming between Runyon Lake and the county line and CPW closed a one-mile stretch; water below the Pueblo Dam was flowing at three times the average rate
location: Arkansas River between Runyon Lake and the Pueblo County line
responding_agency: Pueblo County Sheriff's Office; Colorado Parks and Wildlife
notes: CPR story dated 2015-06-23 ('the death of the Parker man on Sunday') parent-opened this run; incident date = the Sunday before publication, 2015-06-21. Distinct from id 2928 (2014-07-25). Zero Pueblo-2015-06 rows before insertion.
